subject: Science
lessonTitle: The Earth and the Solar System

questions.text: The Sun and the objects revolving around it form the ______ system.
The planets are arranged at different distances from the Sun.
Which planet is closest to the Sun?
Give a reason: Planets do not collide with the Sun while revolving around it.
questions.answer: Because each planet moves in its own orbit under gravitational attraction.

questions.text: Earth rotates around its axis once in about ______ hours.
Give a reason: Day and night occur.
questions.answer: Because Earth rotates around its axis.

questions.text: Earth revolves around the Sun once in about ______ days.
Give a reason: The apparent length of a shadow changes during the day.
questions.answer: Because the angle of sunlight changes as Earth rotates.

questions.text: Sunlight falls on Earth's surface at different angles.

questions.answer: Rotation is Earth's spinning around its axis and causes day and night; revolution is Earth's motion around the Sun and takes about one year.
